idea: Routines & independence #1 – tidy up (AVA'S ROOM): the lid of Baby Ava's pink toy box pops open and her red ball, yellow duck and blue toy car tumble out onto the rug ('Oh no! Oh no! What a mess!'); chorus 'Tidy up, tidy up! Toys go in the box!'; she puts them back one by one – 'Red ball, in the box! Plop!', 'Yellow duck, in the box! Plop!', 'Blue car, in the box! Plop!'; copy-me 'Pick it up! Put it in! Do it with me!' with claps; she asks the viewer 'Where do toys go? Hmm?' – 'In the box! Yay! All tidy!'; lesson 'I can tidy up all by myself!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now the box is closed and the rug tidy, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Tidy up by yourself: pick each toy up and put it back in the toy box.
calendar: Thursday slot 2 – Routines & independence (first tidy-up episode).
characters: Ava (HOME): BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.

supporting_objects.toys: a shiny plain RED rubber ball; a round plain YELLOW rubber duck toy with an orange beak; a chunky toddler toy car in plain BLUE with four black wheels

setting: AVA'S ROOM: a sweet baby girl's bedroom with soft pink walls painted with white clouds and little flowers, yellow curtains with flower tie-backs, a white toddler bed with a yellow flower blanket and a small pink star pillow, a butterfly mobile, a pink toy box with white flowers, a soft white bunny plush, a small dollhouse and a fluffy flower-shaped rug.

learning.goal: Tidy up by yourself: pick up each toy and put it back in the toy box.
learning.shown_how: Three toys tumble out (hook); she puts the red ball, the yellow duck and the blue car into the pink toy box one by one (3 → 2 → 1 → 0 toys on the rug); loop with the box closed and the rug empty.
learning.interactive_moment: ~0:19.2-0:21 'Where do toys go? Hmm?' (question boing ~0:20) → ~0:21 'In the box! Yay! All tidy!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: 0:16-0:19 'Pick it up! Put it in! Do it with me!' (claps)
learning.fact_check: Exactly 3 toys, one plain basic color each (red ball, yellow duck, blue car), counted in every frame; toys leave the rug in the sung order; no text/letters/numbers.
learning.modeling: Ava tidies up by herself, calmly, one toy at a time; the mess is a surprise (toys tumbled out), not naughtiness.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, cozy calm bedroom, one baby, nothing scary, big face.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: toy box pops open
say-it-with-me chorus: Tidy up! In the box!
copy-me: pick it up, put it in, clap
interactive pause: Where do toys go?

story_order.red ball: shots 1-2 out · in the box from shot 2 ~3.8 s
story_order.yellow duck: out in shots 1-3 · in from shot 3 ~4 s
story_order.blue car: out in shots 1-4 · in from shot 4 ~3.5 s
story_order.note: copy-me cuts (16.9-18.8 s) replay the car pick-up/put-in as a 'do it with me' demo
